answer: Timber prism-filing bond: each agent carves a timber artifact, inlays an ivory prism, and files its spectrum in the registry, staking 70 credits. Each epoch a beacon lights it; auditors replay the registry; a duplicate spectrum or reused serial burns the bond. First filing 38, the k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and risk 70,000 more, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-artifact rings fail. One honest filing costs 38, and the bond stays intact.
